```{r}
#| label: setup

if (basename(getwd()) == "country") {
  setwd("../..")
} else if (basename(getwd()) == "pages") {
  setwd("..")
}

source("Scripts/V1_Dashboard_setup.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-country-data
#| include: false

country_iso3 <- toupper(params$iso3)
country_name <- params$country_name
country_region <- params$region
country_region_href <- params$region_href
country_map_src <- params$map_src
country_slug <- params$slug

country_df <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(iso3 == country_iso3, Year == current_year) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Month)

country_plot <- all_country_plots[[country_name]]
if (is.null(country_plot)) {
  country_plot <- make_radial_plot(data %>% dplyr::filter(iso3 == country_iso3), current_year, current_month)
}

ytd_row <- country_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Month <= recent_month) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    ytd_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    ytd_expected = sum(Ave_season_monthly_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ytd_ratio = dplyr::if_else(ytd_expected > 0, ytd_cases / ytd_expected, NA_real_))

badge_class <- if (nrow(ytd_row) == 1) season_badge_state_class(ytd_row$ytd_ratio)[1] else "is-neutral"
badge_label <- if (nrow(ytd_row) == 1) season_badge_label_text(ytd_row$ytd_ratio)[1] else "Season near baseline"

ts_current <- country_df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    month = Month,
    month_label = month.abb[Month],
    cases = as.numeric(cases),
    average_cases = round(as.numeric(Ave_season_monthly_cases), 0),
    source = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(source), "Not available"),
    status = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(cases) ~ "Unobserved",
      dplyr::coalesce(as.character(source), "") == "Estimates" ~ "Estimated",
      "Data_status" %in% names(country_df) &
        !is.na(cases) &
        dplyr::coalesce(as.character(Data_status), "") == "Unobserved" ~ "Estimated",
      TRUE ~ "Observed"
    ),
    # Validation-calibrated 95% prediction intervals applied in V1_Dashboard_setup.R
    # (Scripts/utils/apply_calibrated_intervals.R). Bounds are non-NA only for
    # estimated months; observed months render without whiskers.
    lower95 = dplyr::if_else(status == "Estimated", as.numeric(lower95), NA_real_),
    upper95 = dplyr::if_else(status == "Estimated", as.numeric(upper95), NA_real_)
  )

hist_csv_path <- if (file.exists("Assets/Stable/OD_maps/pred_downscale_with_ci_V3.csv")) {
  "Assets/Stable/OD_maps/pred_downscale_with_ci_V3.csv"
} else if (file.exists("../Assets/Stable/OD_maps/pred_downscale_with_ci_V3.csv")) {
  "../Assets/Stable/OD_maps/pred_downscale_with_ci_V3.csv"
} else {
  "../../Assets/Stable/OD_maps/pred_downscale_with_ci_V3.csv"
}
hist_raw <- read.csv(hist_csv_path, check.names = FALSE)

comparison_years <- seq.int(current_year - 5, current_year - 1)

ts_historic_stable <- hist_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(ISO_A0 == country_iso3, Year %in% comparison_years) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    year = as.character(Year),
    month = as.integer(month),
    month_label = month.abb[as.integer(month)],
    cases = as.numeric(dengue_total_scaled)
  )

ts_historic_output <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(iso3 == country_iso3, Year %in% comparison_years) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    year = as.character(Year),
    month = as.integer(Month),
    month_label = month.abb[as.integer(Month)],
    cases_output = as.numeric(cases)
  )

ts_historic <- ts_historic_stable %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    ts_historic_output,
    by = c("year", "month", "month_label")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cases = dplyr::coalesce(cases_output, cases)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, month, month_label, cases)

format_big <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
}

monthly_phrase <- function(ratio) {
  if (is.na(ratio)) return("close to")
  if (ratio >= 1.30) return("well above")
  if (ratio >= 1.10) return("slightly above")
  if (ratio >= 0.90) return("close to")
  if (ratio >= 0.70) return("slightly below")
  return("well below")
}

season_phrase <- function(ratio) {
  if (is.na(ratio)) return("near")
  if (ratio >= 1.20) return("above")
  if (ratio < 0.85) return("below")
  return("near")
}

relative_level_phrase <- function(ratio) {
  if (is.na(ratio)) return("near")
  if (ratio >= 1.40) return("well above")
  if (ratio >= 1.10) return("above")
  if (ratio >= 0.90) return("near")
  if (ratio >= 0.70) return("below")
  return("well below")
}

last_row <- country_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cases)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date) %>%
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1)
prev_row <- country_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cases), date < last_row$date) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date) %>%
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1)

cases_last_month <- if (nrow(last_row) == 1) last_row$cases[1] else NA_real_
expected_last_month <- if (nrow(last_row) == 1) last_row$Ave_season_monthly_cases[1] else NA_real_
last_month_label <- if (nrow(last_row) == 1) format(as.Date(last_row$date[1]), "%B %Y") else "recent months"

prev_month_label <- if (nrow(prev_row) == 1) format(as.Date(prev_row$date[1]), "%B %Y") else NA_character_
cases_prev_month <- if (nrow(prev_row) == 1) prev_row$cases[1] else NA_real_

monthly_ratio <- if (!is.na(cases_last_month) && !is.na(expected_last_month) && expected_last_month > 0) {
  cases_last_month / expected_last_month
} else {
  NA_real_
}
monthly_vs_expected_phrase <- monthly_phrase(monthly_ratio)

pct_change_value <- if (!is.na(cases_prev_month) && cases_prev_month > 0 && !is.na(cases_last_month)) {
  (cases_last_month - cases_prev_month) / cases_prev_month
} else {
  NA_real_
}

ytd_cases <- if (nrow(ytd_row) == 1) ytd_row$ytd_cases[1] else NA_real_
ytd_ratio <- if (nrow(ytd_row) == 1) ytd_row$ytd_ratio[1] else NA_real_
season_status_phrase <- season_phrase(ytd_ratio)

peak_month <- country_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Ave_season_monthly_cases)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Ave_season_monthly_cases)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Month)
peak_month_label <- if (length(peak_month) == 1 && !is.na(peak_month)) month.name[peak_month] else NA_character_

has_estimated_months <- any(ts_current$status == "Estimated", na.rm = TRUE)

cases_last_month_label <- format_big(cases_last_month)
cases_prev_month_label <- format_big(cases_prev_month)
ytd_cases_label <- format_big(ytd_cases)
ytd_ratio_label <- if (!is.na(ytd_ratio)) sprintf("%.1f", ytd_ratio) else NA_character_
observed_history <- if ("Data_status" %in% names(data)) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      iso3 == country_iso3,
      !is.na(cases),
      dplyr::coalesce(as.character(source), "") != "Estimates",
      dplyr::coalesce(as.character(Data_status), "") != "Unobserved"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date)
} else {
  data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      iso3 == country_iso3,
      !is.na(cases),
      dplyr::coalesce(as.character(source), "") != "Estimates"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date)
}

if (nrow(observed_history) == 0) {
  last_observed_month_label <- "recent months"
} else {
  last_observed_month_label <- format(as.Date(observed_history$date[nrow(observed_history)]), "%B %Y")
}

data_refreshed_date <- latest_update_label

current_trajectory <- if (is.na(pct_change_value)) {
  "stable"
} else if (pct_change_value > 0.05) {
  "increasing"
} else if (pct_change_value < -0.05) {
  "decreasing"
} else {
  "stable"
}

hero_relative_phrase <- relative_level_phrase(ytd_ratio)
trajectory_context_phrase <- "as expected at this time of the year based on trends in previous years"

analysis_sentence_1 <- glue::glue(
  "In {last_month_label}, {country_name} reported {cases_last_month_label} dengue cases, {monthly_vs_expected_phrase} what we would typically expect for this time of year."
)
analysis_sentence_2 <- if (!is.na(prev_month_label) && !is.na(cases_prev_month_label)) {
  glue::glue(
    "Compared with {prev_month_label}, in which {cases_prev_month_label} cases were reported, this is a similar level of reported cases."
  )
} else {
  "Compared with the previous month, this is a similar level of reported cases."
}
analysis_sentence_3 <- glue::glue(
  "So far in {current_year}, the country has recorded {ytd_cases_label} cases-about {ytd_ratio_label}x the expected level-so the season is {season_status_phrase} average to date."
)

hero_status_sentence <- glue::glue(
  "In {current_year} so far, the reported cases are {hero_relative_phrase} the expected number of cases. Cases are currently {current_trajectory}, {trajectory_context_phrase}."
)

chart_host_id <- paste0(country_slug, "TsChart")
canvas_id <- paste0(country_slug, "TsCanvas")
control_id <- paste0(country_slug, "CompareControl")
```

#| label: country-hero
#| echo: false

hero_text <- htmltools::div(
  class = "region-hero-text-block",

    hero_status_sentence,

  ),

htmltools::div(

      class = "region-summary-plot",

    ),
    hero_text
  )
)

htmltools::div(
  class = "country-ts-card",

)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

ts_current_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(ts_current, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
ts_historic_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(ts_historic, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$script(src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"),
  htmltools::tags$script(
    htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
'(function () {
  const tsCurrent = %s;
  const tsHistoric = %s;
  const labels = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];
  const controlHost = document.getElementById("%s");
  const canvasHost = document.getElementById("%s");
  if (!controlHost || !canvasHost) return;
  const historicYears = Array.from(new Set(tsHistoric.map(d => String(d.year)))).sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a)).slice(0, 5);
  const compareOptions = ["5-year Average", ...historicYears];
  const seriesColorMap = {
    "5-year Average": "#6c757d",
    "2025": "#ff7851",
    "2024": "#6cc3d5",
    "2023": "#f3969a",
    "2022": "#ffce67",
    "2021": "#6610f2",
    "2020": "#343a40"
  };
  const colorForSeries = (series) => seriesColorMap[series] || "#607080";
  const toRgba = (hex, alpha) => {
    const clean = hex.replace("#", "");
    const h = clean.length === 3
      ? clean.split("").map(x => x + x).join("")
      : clean;
    const r = parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16);
    const g = parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16);
    const b = parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16);
    return "rgba(" + r + "," + g + "," + b + "," + alpha + ")";
  };
  const monthValue = (arr, month, field) => {
    const row = arr.find(d => Number(d.month) === month);
    if (!row) return null;
    const val = row[field];
    return val === null || val === undefined ? null : Number(val);
  };
  const checkboxWrap = document.createElement("div");
  checkboxWrap.className = "country-ts-checkboxes";
  compareOptions.forEach((v, idx) => {
    const optionId = "%s_compareOption_" + v;
    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.className = "country-ts-checkbox";
    label.setAttribute("for", optionId);
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "checkbox";
    input.id = optionId;
    input.value = v;
    input.checked = idx === 0;
    const text = document.createElement("span");
    text.textContent = v;
    const swatchColor = colorForSeries(v);
    label.style.setProperty("--series-color", swatchColor);
    label.style.setProperty("--series-bg", toRgba(swatchColor, 0.12));
    input.style.accentColor = swatchColor;
    label.appendChild(input);
    label.appendChild(text);
    checkboxWrap.appendChild(label);
  });
  controlHost.replaceChildren(checkboxWrap);
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.id = "%s";
  canvasHost.replaceChildren(canvas);
  const monthStatus = labels.map((_, idx) => {
    const m = idx + 1;
    const row = tsCurrent.find(d => Number(d.month) === m);
    return row ? String(row.status || "") : "Unobserved";
  });
  const casesData = labels.map((_, idx) => monthValue(tsCurrent, idx + 1, "cases"));
  const lower95Data = labels.map((_, idx) => {
    if (monthStatus[idx] !== "Estimated") return null;
    return monthValue(tsCurrent, idx + 1, "lower95");
  });
  const upper95Data = labels.map((_, idx) => {
    if (monthStatus[idx] !== "Estimated") return null;
    return monthValue(tsCurrent, idx + 1, "upper95");
  });
  const averageData = labels.map((_, idx) => monthValue(tsCurrent, idx + 1, "average_cases"));
  const getHistoricSeries = (year) => labels.map((_, idx) => {
    const m = idx + 1;
    const row = tsHistoric.find(d => d.year === year && Number(d.month) === m);
    return row ? Number(row.cases) : null;
  });
  const selectedComparisons = () => Array.from(checkboxWrap.querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]:checked")).map(el => el.value);
  const buildComparisonDatasets = () => {
    const picks = selectedComparisons();
    return picks.map((series) => {
      const isAverage = series === "5-year Average";
      const seriesColor = colorForSeries(series);
      return {
        label: isAverage ? "5-year Average" : series + " season",
        data: isAverage ? averageData : getHistoricSeries(series),
        borderColor: seriesColor,
        backgroundColor: "transparent",
        borderWidth: isAverage ? 2.3 : 2,
        pointRadius: 0,
        spanGaps: true
      };
    });
  };
  const baseDatasets = [
    { label: "Uncertainty upper", data: upper95Data, borderColor: "transparent", backgroundColor: "rgba(13,92,72,0.14)", pointRadius: 0, borderWidth: 0, spanGaps: true, fill: false, order: 1 },
    { label: "Uncertainty lower", data: lower95Data, borderColor: "transparent", backgroundColor: "rgba(13,92,72,0.14)", pointRadius: 0, borderWidth: 0, spanGaps: true, fill: "-1", order: 1 },
    {
      label: "Current year: Cases",
      data: casesData,
      borderColor: "#0d5c48",
      backgroundColor: "transparent",
      borderWidth: 2.6,
      pointRadius: (ctx) => {
        const status = monthStatus[ctx.dataIndex];
        return status === "Estimated" ? 2.8 : (status === "Observed" ? 2.4 : 0);
      },
      pointBackgroundColor: (ctx) => {
        const status = monthStatus[ctx.dataIndex];
        return status === "Estimated" ? "#ffffff" : "#0d5c48";
      },
      pointBorderColor: "#0d5c48",
      pointBorderWidth: (ctx) => {
        const status = monthStatus[ctx.dataIndex];
        return status === "Estimated" ? 2 : 0;
      },
      spanGaps: true,
      segment: {
        borderDash: (ctx) => {
          const targetStatus = monthStatus[ctx.p1DataIndex];
          return targetStatus === "Estimated" ? [6, 4] : [];
        }
      },
      order: 2
    }
  ];
  const baseDatasetCount = baseDatasets.length;
  const uncertaintyWhiskerPlugin = {
    id: "uncertaintyWhiskerPlugin",
    afterDatasetsDraw(chartInstance) {
      const xScale = chartInstance.scales.x;
      const yScale = chartInstance.scales.y;
      if (!xScale || !yScale) return;

      const chartCtx = chartInstance.ctx;
      chartCtx.save();
      chartCtx.strokeStyle = "rgba(13,92,72,0.62)";
      chartCtx.lineWidth = 1.2;

      for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
        const lo = lower95Data[i];
        const hi = upper95Data[i];
        if (lo === null || hi === null) continue;

        const x = xScale.getPixelForValue(i);
        const yLo = yScale.getPixelForValue(lo);
        const yHi = yScale.getPixelForValue(hi);
        const cap = 4;

        chartCtx.beginPath();
        chartCtx.moveTo(x, yHi);
        chartCtx.lineTo(x, yLo);
        chartCtx.moveTo(x - cap, yHi);
        chartCtx.lineTo(x + cap, yHi);
        chartCtx.moveTo(x - cap, yLo);
        chartCtx.lineTo(x + cap, yLo);
        chartCtx.stroke();
      }
      chartCtx.restore();
    }
  };
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const chart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: "line",
    plugins: [uncertaintyWhiskerPlugin],
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: baseDatasets.concat(buildComparisonDatasets())
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false },
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: false },
        tooltip: {
          filter: (tooltipItem) => {
            const idx = tooltipItem.dataIndex;
            const status = monthStatus[idx];
            if (tooltipItem.datasetIndex <= 1) {
              return status === "Estimated";
            }
            return true;
          }
        }
      },
      scales: {
        x: { title: { display: true, text: "Month" }, grid: { display: false } },
        y: { title: { display: true, text: "Cases" }, grid: { display: false } }
      }
    }
  });
  canvas.parentElement.style.minHeight = "360px";
  checkboxWrap.addEventListener("change", () => {
    chart.data.datasets = chart.data.datasets.slice(0, baseDatasetCount).concat(buildComparisonDatasets());
    chart.update();
  });
})();',
      ts_current_json,
      ts_historic_json,
      control_id,
      chart_host_id,
      country_slug,
      canvas_id
    ))
  )
)
```

## Further analysis

`r analysis_sentence_1`

`r analysis_sentence_2`

`r analysis_sentence_3`

The last month with reported cases is **`r last_observed_month_label`**.

In `r country_name` the average peak month is **`r peak_month_label`**.
